answer: The prism ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own sonnet record, and its own share of the velvet quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 1 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 4560 identities would post 953 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
